about_the_game:
Ghost of Tsushima: Legends is an online cooperative multiplayer experience1 inspired by Japanese folk tales and mythology. Choose from four classes – Samurai, Hunter, Ronin or Assassin – and play with friends or via online matchmaking in two-player story missions, four-player survival missions or Rivals Mode.

Key features:

  • Grow your legend: collect powerful gear, hone your abilities and develop new techniques to build the ultimate warrior.

  • Story missions: band together with another player and journey through mythic tales from the mind of storyteller Gyozen in co-op online gameplay.

  • Survival: team up with three other players and fight off waves of enemies as you defend Tsushima.

  • Raid: assemble a four-player team, tackle Iyo’s realm and do your best to survive an epic three-part adventure.

  • Rivals: two teams of two compete to defeat waves of enemies and take the fight to each other.

  • Ghost of Tsushima: Legends is available as a free download for Ghost of Tsushima Director’s Cut owners.

¹Internet connection and account for PlayStation™Network required.

content_descriptors.notes: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends is a multiplayer action game featuring Blood & Gore, and Violence.
